title: In Search of a Hidden Heart
description: The guide who has possessed the Secret Source Servant seems intent on guiding visitors to the "Heart of the Sacred Mountain"... However, getting there appears to require a permit, along with the activation of the Secret Source Dragon Idol guarding the entrance. Perhaps the Secret Source Servant can shed more light on the situation...

dialogs.text: Ah! A Secret Source Servant... Huh. Is it just Paimon, or is this one bigger than the others?
Rawr!
Hehe, fancy meeting you again so soon!
...Apologies, but there are no entries regarding you logged in my database.
Humans this far down... This has not happened in at least 500 years.
Wait, you're not Amaru... or Ehecatl, are you?
...There were indeed individuals referred to as such, but I am neither of them.
I believe there must be some misunderstanding.
I am a prototype created to assist Lord Xiuhcoatl with information recording, so I have no name.
Roar...
Wait... No... Not that I have no name, I...
I am the only intelligent Secret Source Servant without a master. Even after Lord Xiuhcoatl fell, I was still in charge of the most basic...
The most basic city maintenance and information recording functions.
However, some records have been lost due to the invasion of our shadowy foe, so I do not have data regarding my name.
Yeah, seems like we've got the wrong guy... Err, dragon-robot?
It is fine.
Hmm. This robot is huge, but it doesn't seem too bright.
#This probably isn't that guy who uses machines to talk to us, {NICKNAME}...
But it did say that it is in charge of record-keeping and stuff, right?
Why don't we ask it what it knows, then? Or... You know, about how we can reach the Heart of the Sacred Mountain!
Maybe that's what "that guy" intended...
Rawr!
Well, let's fire away, then...

flow.stepDescription: Continue on your path to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain

dialogs.text: Show me the records concerning "Corrosion and Physical Conditions"...
Of course. Now reading, please wait.
Record playback complete.
Please mark the next site Abyssal corrosion site...
Affirmative. It has been marked... Please clear the Abyss-corrupted zone as soon as possible to retrieve the data stored there.
From there, the database may be restored, preserved, and maintained, such that the required content may be accessed.
Show me the entries for "Humans... and Exceptional Individuals Thereof"
Of course. Now reading, please wait.
Record playback complete.
How do we enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain?
The entrance to the Heart is close by. When recreating Tollan's city center, Lord Xiuhcoatl excavated downward in order to create a stable experimental environment...
And there, he built the ultimate weapon for use against the Abyss.
However, the seal has caused this device to suffer from the deepest Abyss corrosion. Thus was the city taken over...
The entrance to the Sacred Mountain's heart lies beneath the fissures in the Sacred City... That is also where our shadowy foe's corruption runs the deepest.
Do you have any other inquiries? Or do you wish to mark out the next location where retrievable data might be stored?
Let's access the data we've recovered...
Reading corresponding content... What records do you need to access?
I don't have further questions...
Understood.
Greetings. New data recovery category detected.
...Entries concerning Source Mechanism energy cores have been updated.
Phlogiston is the main form of energy that powers Source Mechanisms, albeit in a condensed form that closely resembles light.
Stable amounts of Phlogiston Units may be generated via the controlled reaction known as [DATA LOST] allowing for more precise control over energy release.
The energy that a Source Mechanism requires is dependent on both size and the complexity of its operating logic. The quantity of Phlogiston Units a Secret Source Servant requires is [DATA LOST]...
While the larger Secret Source Dragon Idols, in fact, require less — specifically, three in number.
"Information is energy, and energy is information." The data carrier you retrieved counts as a single Phlogiston Unit...
So one "Phlogiston Unit" is one fireball...
Yes, that is one way to look at it. You restored a Phlogiston Unit that had been corrupted by the Abyss. Only then could I extract anything from it...
They can also be used as substitute energy sources for Abyss-corroded Source Mechanisms.
Read me the entries marked "Creating the Secret Source Servants..."
Of course. Now reading, please wait.
Record playback complete.
Where can we get this permit...
According to the agreement and the edict issued by Lord Xiuhcoatl, entry to... The Heart of the Sacred Mountain, also known as "Huitzilopochtli"... the descendants of...
Proceed unto the Chamber of Deliberation to submit an application, and then wait for the permit to be issued.
If you wish to go there, I shall mark its location for you.
Do you have any queries?
How do we enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain?
The entrance to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain is at the newly-excavated entrance... descend into the deepest fissure of the volcano, where it is defended by a Secret Source Dragon Idol.
Moreover, any who wish to gain access to the Heart must also obtain a "permit"...
Only then can you gain the acknowledgement of the Secret Source Dragon Idol that stands guard... Heart of the Sacred Mountain, also known as Huitzilopochtli...
Where can we get this permit...
According to the agreement and the edict issued by Lord Xiuhcoatl, entry to... The Heart of the Sacred Mountain, also known as "Huitzilopochtli"... the descendants of...
Proceed unto the Chamber of Deliberation to submit an application, and then wait for the permit to be issued.
What about the energy source required by Secret Source Dragon Idols?
Now, searching... No corresponding data entry categories... Or perhaps the relevant data, like so much else, has become lost due to the Abyssal corruption of the city...
If you can eliminate the Abyss's influence and retrieve the data, perhaps you might find the entries you seek.
I have marked out a potential data storage location for you. Please eliminate the Abyssal corruption present there to restore the area.
Do you have any queries?
I have no more questions...
Understood.
It's fine. There isn't anything I'd like to read right now.
Understood.
Let's access the data we've recovered...
Apologies, but I do not have any restored data at present...
How do we enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain?
The entrance to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain is at the newly-excavated entrance... descend into the deepest fissure of the volcano, where it is defended by a Secret Source Dragon Idol.
Moreover, any who wish to gain access to the Heart must also obtain a "permit," and for safety reasons...
Only then can you gain the acknowledgement of the Secret Source Dragon Idol that stands guard... Heart of the Sacred Mountain, also known as Huitzilopochtli...
